ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixel coverage in the central lobe regions vs 35% low-intensity black pixels along the perimeter and interior streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains three prominent, longitudinal dark streaks originating from the trailing edge; right lobe features one distinct thin vertical dark line and localized dark mottling near the median notch; both lobes are bounded by a continuous dark perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-bottom focal point; estimated pixel angle of 40 degrees with a depth of approximately 12% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-frequency serration; left lobe trailing edge displays deep, irregular peaks and valleys (amplitude 15-25 pixels); right lobe displays more frequent, smaller-scale jaggedness (amplitude 5-10 pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong upward convex sweep ending in tapered, slightly recurved tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white high-contrast pixel groups localized on the dark leading edges of the left and right tips, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear dark mark on the right lobe; multiple shorter, diagonal parallel streaks (rake marks) localized on the upper section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged trailing edge excisions; significant vertical linear scarring on the right lobe; barnacle clusters on leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique tripartite 'claw-like' pigmentation pattern on the left lobe's central white field.
